title: HarvestStats
description: Press H to see exactly how many of each crop you've harvested, with percentages and progress bars saved permanently per world.
body:
**HarvestStats**

Ever wondered how many crops you've harvested? HarvestStats keeps track of every harvest and shows detailed statistics for each crop.

![Stats](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/6c0f9871911dfed3498d1f09259835bf69f69d8a.png)

Open the statistics screen with H to view harvest counts, percentages, and progress bars. Your progress is saved automatically and stored separately for every world.

**Features**

Press H to open your harvest statistics.
View the total harvested amount for every supported crop.
See percentages and progress bars in a clean interface.
Right-Click Harvest
Right-click fully grown crops to harvest and automatically replant them in one click.
Auto Harvest
Automatically harvest fully grown crops within a 3-block radius.
Can be enabled or disabled in the settings.

**Per-World Data**

Statistics are stored separately for every world.
Progress is automatically saved.
Reset Statistics
Reset your statistics at any time.
Includes a confirmation screen to prevent accidental resets.

**Requirements**
Minecraft 1.21.1
Fabric Loader
Fabric API
